name: Survey tile in Leo
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 2.3 degrees north of the ecliptic in Leo, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 31 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 31 hours starting 2025-12-02, at wavelengths from 1.11 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
